payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: FATE-M, difficulty: easy).

Informal statement:
For every positive integer n at least two, the ring of integers modulo n is a field if and only if n is prime.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n

The reasoner should give a strategy (use search_lemmas to find relevant Mathlib results), the engineer should formalise and verify with check_lean, and the critic should review faithfulness.

tool_responses.content:
Top matches (name signature -- description):
ZMod.instField : Field (ZMod p)  -- ZMod p is a Field for Prime p
ZMod.instField.congr_simp  ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], ZMod.instField p = ZMod.instField p  -- Congruence Simplification for Field Structure on ZMod p
Nat.prime_iff_card_units  (p : ℕ) [Fintype (ZMod p)ˣ] : p.Prime ↔ Fintype.card (ZMod p)ˣ = p - 1  -- Prime iff Unit Group Cardinality is p-1
Field.nonempty_iff  {α : Type u} : Nonempty (Field α) ↔ IsPrimePow #α  -- Existence of Finite Fields iff Cardinality is a Prime Power
ZMod.isUnit_prime_iff_not_dvd  {n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) ↔ ¬p ∣ n  -- A prime is a unit modulo n if and only if it does not divide n
